title: Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate
description: Hands-on cybersecurity skills including SQL, Linux, IDS, Python, and AI for security. Covers security operations, incident response, threat detection, and SIEM tools.

title: Google Cloud Cybersecurity Professional Certificate
description: Cloud-focused cybersecurity covering Google Compute Engine, cloud security architecture, cloud network security, and perimeter protection.

title: SANS FOR508: Advanced Incident Response, Threat Hunting, and Digital Forensics
description: Advanced DFIR course covering threat hunting, APT detection, memory forensics, timeline analysis, and enterprise-scale incident response. Leads to GCFA certification.

title: SANS FOR610: Reverse-Engineering Malware
description: Hands-on malware analysis covering static and dynamic analysis, code-level reversing, unpacking, deobfuscation, and behavioural analysis of real-world malware samples.

title: SANS SEC504: Hacker Tools, Techniques, and Incident Handling
description: Foundational incident handling and penetration testing course covering attack techniques, vulnerability assessment, and defensive strategies. Leads to GCIH certification.

title: SANS SEC560: Enterprise Penetration Testing
description: Advanced penetration testing methodology covering network attacks, web app exploitation, Active Directory attacks, and professional reporting.

title: SANS FOR578: Cyber Threat Intelligence
description: Structured approach to cyber threat intelligence covering intelligence lifecycle, MITRE ATT&CK framework, attribution, threat modelling, and strategic intelligence production.

title: NUS-ISS AI and Cybersecurity
description: Covers AI-specific cybersecurity including adversarial AI, AI model security, prompt injection defence, and responsible AI practices in cybersecurity applications.

title: NUS-ISS Cyber Security for ICT Professionals
description: Equips ICT professionals with cybersecurity knowledge to incorporate security into development, operations, and infrastructure management. Covers threat landscape, secure coding, and security architecture.

title: ITEL Advanced Certificate in Cyber Security (SCTP)
description: SkillsFuture Career Transition Programme covering SOC operations, threat detection, vulnerability assessment, incident response, and GRC fundamentals for career switchers.

title: NTU Advanced Professional Certificate in Data Science and AI (SCTP)
description: SkillsFuture career transition programme covering Python, machine learning, deep learning, data engineering, and AI deployment for production systems.

title: AWS Solutions Architect Associate
description: Prepare for the AWS SAA certification covering EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, Lambda, and cloud architecture best practices for production workloads.

title: AWS Security Specialty Certification
description: Advanced cloud security covering data protection, incident response in AWS, infrastructure security, identity management, and logging/monitoring.

title: Docker and Kubernetes: The Complete Guide
description: Learn containerization with Docker and container orchestration with Kubernetes including deployments, services, and Helm charts.

title: Python for Data Science and Machine Learning
description: Comprehensive course covering Python fundamentals, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn, and TensorFlow for data science workflows.

title: Machine Learning Engineering with MLOps
description: Production ML engineering covering MLflow, model serving, monitoring, CI/CD for ML, and feature stores.

title: Terraform Associate Certification Prep
description: Learn Infrastructure as Code with Terraform covering providers, modules, state management, and multi-cloud deployments.

title: OffSec Certified Professional (OSCP)

title: OffSec Exploit Developer (OSED)
description: Advanced Windows exploit development covering buffer overflows, SEH exploitation, shellcode, ROP chains, and ASLR/DEP bypass techniques.

title: Specialist Diploma in Cloud Computing (SkillsFuture)

title: SQL for Data Analysis
description: Master SQL querying including joins, subqueries, window functions, CTEs, and performance optimization for analytics.

title: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
description: Prepare for the GCP PCA certification covering compute, storage, networking, security, and cloud-native design patterns.

title: Power BI Data Analyst Associate
description: Learn data visualization, DAX, data modeling, and dashboard design using Microsoft Power BI for business intelligence.

title: Tableau Desktop Specialist
description: Data visualization and analytics using Tableau covering calculated fields, parameters, dashboards, and storytelling with data.

title: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
description: Gold-standard cybersecurity management certification covering 8 domains: security operations, asset security, identity management, software security, and more.

title: Project Management Professional (PMP)
description: Industry-standard project management certification covering predictive, agile, and hybrid methodologies. Recognized globally across all industries.

title: Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
description: Covers ethical hacking methodology, reconnaissance, system hacking, malware threats, sniffing, social engineering, web app attacks, and cloud security.

title: SANS ICS515: ICS Visibility, Detection, and Response
description: OT/ICS cybersecurity covering SCADA security, industrial network monitoring, ICS threat detection, and incident response for critical infrastructure.
